sources.title: Government of Odisha: General Administration Department functions
sources.excerpt: istrative Reforms, Pension and Public Grievances, Maintaining CCRs of Senior Group-A Officers, Rules of Business of Government and advising Government Departments on common service rules / conditions. There are key public institutions working within the ambit of the Department such as Odisha Public Service Commission, Odisha Staff Selection Commission, Odisha Sub-ordinate Staff Selection Commission assigned with the task of recruitment and Gopabandhu Academy of Administration assigned with the task of training and capacity building.
